headline: Mexican cartel boss on FBI most wanted list arrested
pages: Mexican special forces arrested Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, a drug lord on the FBI's 10 most wanted list, after a shoot-out in Guasave, in the state of Sinaloa, on Friday. Mexico's defense secretariat said his second in command was also detained. Meza Flores leads the Meza Flores Organization, also known as the Guasave Cartel, and is thought to have trafficked drugs since the 1990s while keeping a low profile. The FBI accuses him of flooding the US with fentanyl, cocaine and heroin, and the US is seeking his extradition. Officials said troops used US intelligence on his location and surrounded the site before coming under fire from guns and explosives.

Videos online appear to show helicopters firing toward the ground and people fleeing a baseball stadium. Both men were flown to Mexico City to face prosecution. Why it matters: Mexico has stepped up action against cartels under pressure from President Trump. Source: BBC.
